svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Make two from 10 mm plate, about 230 x 272, cut to the outline.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Sizes along from the bottom left corner of the outline (the corner

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: over the skid ends) and up from the bottom edge, which stands on

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the end cross tube. The outline bulges 21 left of that corner.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Shaft hole 40.5 at 32 along, 206 up (266 above the ground).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Pawl shaft hole 16.5 (+Y plate) at 166 along, 119 up.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Catch shaft hole 16.5 (-Y plate) at 191 along, 215 up.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Crank pin access hole 31 (+Y plate) at 108 along, 131 up.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Ream the shaft holes in both plates clamped together, after

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: welding, with a 40 mm bar through both to keep them in line.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Rest stop bar 30 mm at 54 along, 128 up, welded across.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: inner faces 120 apart; the hub (100 long) sits between

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: them on two 10 mm washers. Ties weld to the outer faces.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: a 40 mm bar slides through both shaft holes.
